_comment: editorconfig-checker configuration, read by the style.yml job and by a local run of
IndentSize is disabled on purpose: .editorconfig declares width 3 for C++ and C#,
and the checker reads that as 'every indented line must be a multiple of three',
which condemns the continuation-line alignment that dotnet format itself produces
(2,110 lines, most of them in the formatted C# tree). Indent STYLE (spaces, never
tabs) is still checked, as are the final newline and trailing whitespace where
The excluded paths are the trees that still carry tabs from the original
hMailServer sources: 284 of the C++ server's files, two SQL CE headers under
libraries/, one installer helper and two files of an old test project. They are
excluded, not ignored: the roadmap carries the conversion, and the exclusion
comes off with it. Everything else in the repository is checked.
